project.name: Handover
project.productType: Developer-tool onboarding for handing work to named agents

typography.weight: 400 body, 500 labels and titles, 600 only for compact emphasis

motion.principle: Animate continuity and status only; never delay navigation for decoration

patterns: clickable four-layer Space deck with a pronounced hover fan that uses one smooth Motion layout transition to become a compact, completely aligned single column
Notion public Card surface for Spaces: white, 10% black keyline, 12px radius, no top strip, and interaction-only layered shadow
Transitions.dev-style bottom sheet fixed to the viewport edge, rising from positive Y with 400ms open, 350ms close, opacity, and 2px blur

Motion UI-inspired single white sheet surface with a grab handle, no header divider, a bare close control, a white editable field plus a soft-grey disabled URL field sharing the Notion focus language, and a full-width CTA
single-line copyable shell snippet as the only Notion Card in an otherwise unboxed group
read-only agent result cards with vendor SVG mark, agent name, and version after a machine arrives
live-Notion-measured 270px Home sidebar with a static 32px Workspace identity pill; the Space switcher popup is deferred

Notion sidebar micro-interactions: hover-revealed 24px collapse control, 6px-radius closed hamburger, 20ms hover and pressed fills, compound 200ms width/fade/translate motion, 12px pointer/keyboard resize rail, and hover scrollbar

must: Keep all onboarding copy concise and task-oriented.
Use Notion's white, warm-grey surfaces, hairline borders, compact controls, and blue accent.
Keep onboarding top-anchored: a centered half-viewport progress rail above a centered 480px content column; do not add an outer task card.
Keep the existing two-step journey and top progress indicator.
New Space is always shown as a full-width labelled trigger; hover does not change its width.
The bottom sheet closes on Escape, its close control, or a pointer press anywhere outside the sheet.

Several existing Spaces start as a card deck and expand through a normal height transition into a compact aligned single column; do not deal, stagger, rotate, or use bento. One Space stays directly selectable.
Space cards use Notion's public white Card surface, 10% black keyline, 12px radius, and interaction-only layered shadow; do not add coloured accents or top strips.
The create form does not ask for or modify the person's name; it only asks for Workspace name.
Workspace URL is disabled and preserves readable Unicode.

The command is the only Notion Card surface; the key fallback is a quiet text action on its label row, while Skip is an equally quiet text action with a right arrow aligned opposite the waiting status.

Regular and key setups occupy the same fixed grid cell and switch instantly without fades or reflow; title, command card, and status coordinates stay identical, and long keys scroll only inside the command text.

After a machine arrives, each discovered agent is a read-only card with its SVG mark, name, and version; agents are never links, buttons, hover targets, or tab stops, and Open Space is the only control.
Home reproduces the live Notion sidebar's measured DOM hierarchy, dimensions, computed colors, shadow, and extracted SVG paths rather than approximating them.
The Workspace icon/name pill is static until the deferred Space switcher is deliberately resumed; the sidebar never exposes a permanent Spaces list.
Home sidebar interactions reproduce Notion's measured hover, pressed, collapse/reopen width-fade-translate motion, resize, scrollbar, and focus states rather than stopping at a static screenshot.
Existing Space selection enters that Space immediately. Creating a Space enters it too — there is no step between, and connecting a machine happens inside the Space.
avoid: Do not add Tailwind or shadcn dependencies; adapt inspiration to the existing CSS system.
Do not use modal dialogs for Space creation, carousel onboarding, illustrations, coachmarks, or a four-step wizard.
Do not use heavy black terminal windows, shimmer text, decorative percentages, avatars, or excessive helper copy.
Do not create multiple equal-weight primary buttons.
Do not turn a request to reproduce a reference UI into an impressionistic restyling; inspect the live DOM, computed CSS, SVGs, and interaction hierarchy.
Do not invent user-visible nouns or change the public protocol.

decisions: The login page is approved and must not be redesigned.
The progress rail spans half the desktop viewport while the task content remains a centered 480px column.
New Space is always a full-width labelled trigger and opens a non-modal sheet fixed to the viewport bottom; it never expands beneath the trigger or replaces the card list.
The progress rail remains visually persistent while task content changes in place.

Multiple Spaces form a compact deck with a pronounced hover fan before a normal Motion height transition restores a completely aligned single column; the deck is composition, while the card surface follows Notion's public Card component.
21st components are references, not packages to install.
